reason: The seq-1 read took H off the -09 row of a table whose rows are grouped in blocks of three with blank lines between; it had registered one row low and reported the -10 row's H. Re-rendered at Matrix(8) against the block boundary. The slot_phase absence is also withdrawn: requirement 12, which the first read missed, does control it.

slot_phase.note: A correction may also promote an absence to a value -- which is the case the projection has to get right, because the absence must stop being reported at the same moment.
